title: hub-relay-order
description: The shared order a client lists relay channels in inside a group card: one array of relay ids (the <id> of renewvan/relay/<id>/...), first to last. A presentation choice, so it lives here and never on the relay's own topics. Published retained by the hub plugin to renewvan/hub/relay-order, restored from the value it persisted on the Pi and published on every (re)connect, default []; replaced whole by a client sending the same payload, unretained, to renewvan/hub/relay-order/set; a client never writes the state topic. Up to 512 distinct ids; the hub plugin does not know which relays exist, so it checks only the shape. A relay missing from the array sorts after the listed ones, and an id that is not on the bus is ignored by a consumer.
